variants.title: 02 / 装配工作台
variants.prompt: Create one polished high-fidelity Chinese PC game equipment modification UI design reference, 1920x1080 landscape composition, flat screenshot filling frame, no monitor mockup. Cold Steel Archive / 冷钢档案 visual rules: restrained charcoal layered surfaces #171D23 and #10151A, controls #28323B, primary text #DCE2E6, secondary #B5C0C8, delicate silver outlines, pale silver-blue #B8D6DF selected accents, modest 6-10px corners, no neon glow, no gold ornament, no orange main buttons. Primary action light silver with dark text, secondary buttons dark gray. Small muted mint only for beneficial numerical changes, muted amber for cost. Chinese Song/serif typography, numeric Consolas-like monospaced. Generous deliberate layout spacing, strong readable hierarchy, premium tactical editorial style, not sci-fi HUD clutter. Use realistic isolated 3D M4 rifle matching provided reference's brown-gray receiver, black stock, holographic optic and dark round single drum below magwell. Reference is for weapon identity only, redesign layout completely, no world portals, sky, hotbar, health HUD or debug text. All design text Chinese, exact large title and major labels legible. Common consistent scenario: standard magazine 30 rounds -> selected large drum 50 rounds; ADS 240 -> 209 ms; ordinary reload 2.70 -> 4.73 s; empty reload 3.47 -> 6.07 s. These are final derived results. Selected holographic sight 1×. Show clear draft state '待应用 · 1 项', actions '撤销更改', '应用并保存', close 'Esc 返回'. Do not invent damage increase, recoil numbers, currency cost, lock gates or attachment ownership counts. This is a design concept, not a game screenshot; subtly label footer '页面设计参考'. Only currently available optic and magazine selectable; additional categories may be muted '待扩展'. Completely distinct full-screen armorer bench with no world visible. Top narrow global header '装备改造 / M4A1'. Left narrow vertical category rail 12% width with 瞄具, 弹匣 active options; muted other rows 枪口, 枪托, 握把 with 待扩展. Massive center 58% wide high-quality rifle side render on softly illuminated graphite presentation surface, subtle technical scale ticks only, small precise white label leaders to installed holographic and drum (do not obscure silhouette). Right 25% '改造后属性' summary with final values and small before values. Bottom beneath preview a wide horizontal carousel two spacious attachment thumbnail cards, selected drum. Bottom action strip constant. Title '02 / 装配工作台'. Clear central workbench, make weapon asset beautiful and the actual focus.

retentionNote: Only the approved 02 layout source is retained here. Historical styling in its prompt is not the current UI rule. Original five-variant manifest is archived; see Docs/UI/panel-workflow-archive-20260913.json.
